healthLayers.protocol: initialize, tools/list, media_capabilities over strict UTF-8 JSON-RPC stdio
healthLayers.gatewayCatalog: authenticated GET /v1/models; last check only, timestamp and count are reported
healthLayers.generationCapability: not proven until a user-approved real generation succeeds

tools.name: media_refresh_models
tools.persists: non-secret model IDs, gateway URL and catalog timestamp

tools.name: media_capabilities
tools.description: Show local configuration and most recent gateway catalog status; generationCapability remains not_tested until separately authorized real generation.

tools.name: media_prepare
tools.description: Validate inputs and write a signed, expiring, immutable confirmation manifest.
